description: This Java source file defines a test suite class 'EntityCryptoTestSuite' that extends 'EntityTestCase'. It contains automated tests for cryptographic features of the entity layer in the Apache OFBiz framework, testing encryption, decryption, cryptographic storage, lookup, sub-element queries, and ensuring proper behavior of encrypted fields within entity objects.

classes.name: EntityCryptoTestSuite
classes.description: A test suite class for testing cryptographic operations on entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testCrypto
methods.description: Tests basic cryptographic operations: setting, storing, retrieving, and verifying encrypted and unencrypted values in an entity.

methods.name: testCryptoEncryption
methods.description: Validates the encryption and decryption process, ensuring encrypted values differ from plaintext and are correctly retrieved, including testing salted encryption and raw encrypted value consistency.

methods.name: testCryptoLookup
methods.description: Tests querying entities based on encrypted fields, including null and specific value lookups, ensuring correct filtering.

methods.name: makeSubSelectCondition
methods.description: Creates an entity condition with sub-select logic filtering on testingCryptoTypeId and encryptedValue.

methods.name: makeSubSelect
methods.description: Constructs a sub-select entity condition using 'makeSubSelectCondition' for use in queries.

methods.name: testCryptoSubSelect
methods.description: Performs tests involving sub-select queries, verifying filtered results based on sub-conditions and encrypted values.
